description: React component for managing and displaying groups of teams and channels in the Mattermost admin console, including collapse/expand functionality, role management, and rendering a table of team/channel entries.

classes.name: GroupTeamsAndChannels
classes.description: React component class for displaying and managing group teams and channels, with collapse/expand and role assignment functionalities.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state with collapsed groups.

methods.name: onToggleCollapse
methods.description: Toggles the collapsed state of a team or channel group.

methods.name: onRemoveItem
methods.description: Calls parent handler to remove a team or channel item.

methods.name: onChangeRoles
methods.description: Calls parent handler to change roles for a team or channel.

methods.name: teamsAndChannelsToEntries
methods.description: Converts team and channel data into a sorted list of entries for rendering.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component UI, including loading state, empty state, and the table of teams and channels.
